section: Vishnukundin art and architecture - Undavalli, Mogalrajapuram and Bhairavakonda caves

accepted.s: The two-day “Telugu Mahotsavam” held at Undavalli Caves in July 2026 was conducted on which dates?
accepted.x: The two-day “Telugu Mahotsavam” at Undavalli Caves was held on 25–26 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the precise date range and eliminate the options shifted by one day.

accepted.s: Who announced that the “Telugu Mahotsavam” would become an annual festival held in every region?
o: The Chief Secretary of Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: Minister Kandula Durgesh announced at the close of the festival that it would become an annual festival held in every region.
accepted.tq: Identify the person associated with the specific announcement rather than the venue or organising authority.

accepted.s: Undavalli Caves are situated within which of the following areas?
o: The Visakhapatnam metropolitan region, in Bheemunipatnam mandal
The Tirupati temple area, in Chandragiri mandal
The Kurnool urban area, in Orvakal mandal
The Amaravati capital area, in Tadepalli mandal
accepted.x: Undavalli Caves lie inside the Amaravati capital area, specifically in Tadepalli mandal.
accepted.tq: Apply the location test by matching the monument with its mandal and broader regional setting.

accepted.s: Which dynasty is associated with the first Hindu cave temples in the Telugu states?
accepted.x: The Vishnukundins are associated with the first Hindu cave temples in the Telugu states.
accepted.tq: Use the first-in-sequence clue to distinguish the Vishnukundins from other Andhra dynasties.
